## Manifesto check

Tick each rule in MANIFESTO.md this change keeps. If one doesn't apply, tick it anyway; if one is broken, the change doesn't ship.

- [ ] 1. No paywall: every feature in this change works without paying
- [ ] 2. No subscription, ad or account added
- [ ] 3. No gimmick: no streaks, badges, fake urgency, confirm-shaming or review prompts
- [ ] 4. No new notification, or one that is opt-in and off by default
- [ ] 5. Works with AI off; with AI off, no AI UI shows and nothing AI-related leaves the device
- [ ] 6. Any AI runs on the device
- [ ] 7. No analytics, telemetry or tracking added; no data leaves the device
- [ ] 8. Exports still contain everything
- [ ] 9. No new dependency, or the reason is given below
- [ ] 10. Any health claim or recommendation cites its evidence; estimates are shown as ranges
- [ ] 11. Guardrails still hold (safe rates, floors, minors); no moralising copy about food or bodies
